name: How long does a floor plan reconfiguration project typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a floor plan reconfiguration project typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A floor plan reconfiguration takes between 6 to 16 weeks of active construction, depending on project scope. A targeted reconfiguration, such as taking down a single partition wall between a kitchen and living room, may wrap up in 4 to 6 weeks. A whole-house layout overhaul involving multiple load-bearing walls, stair relocations, and new bathroom plumbing branches typically runs 3 to 4 months or longer. Pre-construction steps—including drafting layout options, structural engineering calculations, and securing city permits—typically add an initial 3 to 8 weeks before work begins on-site.
acceptedAnswer.description: Active construction usually takes 6 to 16 weeks, preceded by 3 to 8 weeks for layout design, engineering, and city permit approvals.
